snippet.title: Horse Runner DX - Official Update 1.1.4 Trailer
snippet.description:
AVAILABLE NOW on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2955320/Horse_Runner_DX/

Horse Runner DX is a wholesome, fast-paced platformer with a twist: You play a whole herd of horses! Combine different horses and power-ups, complete increasingly difficult challenges, chase new highscores and enjoy the ride from cute to chaotic fun.

Horse Runner DX was created with a lot of attention to detail by a single indie developer. It's a love letter to classic console games that emphasize simple yet engaging gameplay. It was inspired by games like Alto's Odyssey, Robot Unicorn Attack, Canabalt, and Bit.Trip Runner.

This trailer showcases new horses, improved graphics, and improved physics. Thanks to all players for the lovely feedback!

#gaming #steam #horse #pixelart
